The '''Crystal Falls''' were lavafalls located in the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The falls were a rich source of crystalline [[Ore/Legends|ore]]; the area at their base was covered with rocks that had grown from the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] minerals that flew out of the falls.<ref name="SWG:TCFM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Falls were a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystal Falls were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TCFM" />
